title: Build, Buy or Teach It
segs: Chapter 31. Build, Buy or Teach It.

August ke teesre hafte mein VaultLeaf naam ke ek vendor ne Sahaj mein do log bheje. Vendor woh company hai jo aapko product bechti hai. Ek salesman tha aur ek engineer. Imran Qureshi ne kaha ki do bhejna achha sanket hai. Lakshmi Iyer ne kaha ki yeh bura sanket hai.

VaultLeaf aisa software bechta tha jo text mein personal data dhoondhta aur chhupata tha. Woh banks ko bechta tha. Uska pitch chamakdaar tha. Graphs wali ek console (control screen) thi, aur ek slide par certificate. Usne waada kiya ki woh teen hafte mein Sahaj mein chalne lagega, nabbe-nau pratishat accuracy ke saath.

Anaya ne poocha ki nabbe-nau pratishat kiske saamne naapa gaya. Engineer ko jaise isi sawaal ki ummeed thi. Usne kaha ki woh VaultLeaf ke apne benchmark (apne test) ke saamne naapa gaya. Toh Anaya ne poocha ki kya Sahaj product ko apne test par chala sakta hai.
Case: sab ke liye ek hi test.

Us dukaandaar ko dekhiye jo kehta hai ki uska taraazu sahi hai. Aap behes nahi karte. Aap us par ek kilo ka batkhara rakh dete hain. Jab koi aapko woh bechna chahe jo aapki team bana sakti hai, toh sabse pehle yahi karna hai. Zyadatar khareedaar yahi chhod dete hain. Baat aam taur par price aur demo par ghoomti hai. Dono faisla nahi karte. Faisla is se hota hai ki vendor ke product ko usi tarah naapiye jaise apna naapte. Apni answer key aur apne tarah ke text par.
VaultLeaf do sau chaar rows chalane ko maan gaya. Usne aise kiya ki lage ki woh aisa kam hi karta hai. Ek hafte baad aankde aaye.

English identity numbers par woh shaandaar tha, guard se thoda behtar. Hinglish names par, jis kaam ke liye guard bana tha, usne sau mein bayaasi mile. Devanagari script ke Hindi par woh aur kharab tha. Shabdon mein likhe number ko sambhalne ka usme koi tareeka nahi tha. Salesman ko hairaani nahi hui. Usne kaha ki company ke zyadatar customers English-first hain. Anaya ne kaha ki Sahaj ke nahi hain.

Jawaab mein ek doosra jawaab bhi tha, aur Lakshmi ne use teen baar padha. Standard product text ko processing ke liye VaultLeaf ke cloud mein bhejta tha, India se bahar ke ek region mein. Ek private deployment (product Sahaj ke apne systems ke andar lagaya jaaye) lagbhag teen guni keemat par mil sakta tha.
Aap asal mein kya khareed rahe hain.
Imran shaant raha. Usne kaha ki vendor theek hai, bas sab ko pata ho ki paise kis ke liye hain. Aap shayad hi kabhi model khareedte hain, kyunki zyadatar vendors wahi models use karte hain.

Aap connectors aur permissions khareedte hain. Aap kisne kya kiya uska record aur ek support contract khareedte hain. Aap ek aisa insaan khareedte hain jo raat ke do baje kuch toote toh bistar se uthe. Yeh aakhri cheez aam taur par licence se zyada keemti hoti hai. Yeh aksar hisaab se bahar chhod di jaati hai. Lift khareedne ko dekhiye. Aap us aadmi ke paise bhi dete hain jo lift atakne par aata hai.
Usne board par chaar sawaal likhe. Uske tajurbe mein inhi se faisla hota hai.

Table 31.1: Build ya buy ke chaar sawaal, aur Sahaj ke jawaab. Kya product isi kaam ke liye hai, ya yeh plumbing hai? Sahaj ka jawaab: Hinglish mein personal details dhoondhna poore case ki buniyaad hai, toh Sahaj ko ise apna rakhna chahiye. Ise kitni baar badalna padega? Sahaj ka jawaab: Lagaatar, kyunki answer key har hafte badhti hai aur failures asli customers se aate hain. Raat ke do baje kaun jaaga hai? Sahaj ka jawaab: Abhi koi nahi. Koi plan nahi tha, jo jaanne layak baat thi. Agar vendor ko koi khareed le ya woh band ho jaaye toh kya hoga? Sahaj ka jawaab: VaultLeaf mein koi nahi bata saka ki chhodne mein kya lagega.

Phir team ne ek sheet par do saal ke andaaze banaye. Private deployment khareedna lagbhag ₹58 lakh aaya. Guard ko banana aur chalana lagbhag ₹71 lakh aaya. Farq itna chhota tha ki dono taraf behes ho sakti thi, isliye hisaab ne faisla nahi kiya. Imran ke rule ne kiya. Plumbing khareediye. Woh hissa banaiye jo product ko alag banata hai.

Plan tha ki finder, answer key aur scoreboard banaye jaayen. Sirf aam cheezein kiraye par li jaayengi. Yeh the India ke region mein models ki hosting, aur logs ke liye ek ready-made console. Kuch bhi sign karne se pehle Anaya ne woh likha jo usne likhna seekha tha.
Hal kiya hua udaharan: Ek date wala faisla.

Main khareedne par aa jaaunga agar VaultLeaf hamari key par Hinglish names mein nabbe tak pahunch jaaye, ya agar upkeep kisi ek insaan ke time ka paanchwa hissa se zyada kha jaaye. Main zyada khud banane par aa jaaunga agar agle tier par price badhe. Review 1 December ko.
Usne paaya ki date wala faisla, bina date wale se, palatna kahin aasaan hai.
Product ke neeche kya hai.

Wapas chalte hue Anaya ne Imran se woh sawaal poocha jo woh March se liye ghoom rahi thi. Kya woh un logon se muqabla kar rahe hain jo bade models banate hain? Woh mithai ki dukaan ke saamne ruka. Phir usne jawaab ek invoice ki peeth par banaya, dukaandaar se maange pen se.

Manzilon wali ek imaarat ko dekhiye. Har manzil neeche wali par khadi hai. AI products aisi hi layers mein bante hain. Poore stack ko AI value chain kehte hain. Har layer ka edge alag cheez se aata hai.

Table 31.2: AI value chain ki layers. Infrastructure. Yeh kya hai: Computers, chips aur cloud. Iska advantage kahan se aata hai: Scale aur paisa. Models. Yeh kya hai: Kuch un companies ke jo access bechti hain, kuch khule roop mein jaari kiye gaye. Iska advantage kahan se aata hai: Scale aur paisa. Tooling. Yeh kya hai: Matlab ke nakshon ke stores, testing aur tracking ke saadhan. Iska advantage kahan se aata hai: Scale aur paisa, aur istemaal ki aasaani. Applications. Yeh kya hai: Jo logon ke asal mein kaam aata hai. Iska advantage kahan se aata hai: Workflow, data aur bharosa.

Imran ne kaha ki zyadatar teams sabse upar ki manzil par rehti hain. Wahan model edge nahi hai. Muqabla karne wale wahi model usi darwaaze se call kar sakte hain. Jo copy karna mushkil hai, woh yeh hai ki product kisi ke rozmarra ke kaam ke andar kitna gehra baitha hai. Aisa data jo kisi aur ke paas nahi, woh bhi copy karna mushkil hai.

Anaya ne corrections ko misaal ke taur par diya. Jab bhi Farah ka koi agent "guard ne woh chhupa diya jo mujhe chahiye tha" dabata hai, team kuch aisa seekhti hai jo kisi competitor ko nahi pata. Lekin yeh tabhi sach hai jab data unique ho, product ko behtar banaye, aur paana mushkil ho. Jo data edge in teeno mein se kisi mein fail ho, woh sirf ek kahani hai.

Kuch models sabke liye khule hain. Open-weight model ke weights chhape hote hain. Weights model ke andar ke woh numbers hain jinme usne jo seekha woh rehta hai. Sabke liye chhapi recipe ko dekhiye. Aap use download karke apne computers par chala sakte hain, kisi aur ke model ko call karne ke bajaye. Yeh models aam taur par sabse achhe closed models se thode peeche rehte hain. Badle mein, data kahan jaata hai aur kitna kharch hota hai, us par aapka zyada control hota hai. Iski keemat aap hosting aur upkeep mein dete hain.

Jis company ne waada kiya tha ki customer ka ek bhi sentence building se bahar nahi jaayega, uske liye chunaav aasaan tha. Isne Anaya ki spec ke haashiye ke sawaal ka jawaab bhi de diya. Savdhaan judge ek open-weight model hoga, Sahaj ke apne servers par chalta hua.

Phir Imran ne ek shabd joda jisne vendor ke daftar mein bahut bhaar uthaya tha. Lock-in ka matlab hai ek provider se bandh jaana kyunki chhodna bahut mehnga hai. Keemat rewriting, dobara naapna ya khoye hue features ho sakti hai. Aise phone plan ko dekhiye jisme chhodne par number chala jaata hai. Ilaaj answer key mein hai. Agar aapka test set kisi vendor par nirbhar nahi, toh badalne mein din lagte hain.
Sikhaya jaaye.
Somvaar ko founder, Mr. Bhatia, ne Anaya ko galiyaare mein roka. Usne plane mein kuch padha tha. Company apna model Hinglish par kyun train na kare? Sab kar rahe the, aur woh Sahaj ka apna hota.

Har team se yeh poocha jaata hai. Aam taur par planning meeting mein, aur aksar kisi ke yeh bataane se pehle ki galti kya hai. Haan kehna poori quarter (teen mahine) baandh deta hai. Na kehna ambitious nahi lagta. Anaya ne Friday tak jawaab dene ka waada kiya.

Is idea ko fine-tuning kehte hain. Ek cricket khiladi ko bahut se practice balls se coach karne ko dekhiye, jab tak achhi aadat pak jaaye. Aap ek maujood model lete hain aur use apne examples par aur train karte hain. Yeh aisa model paane ka seedha raasta lagta hai jo company ki duniya jaanta ho.

Anaya ke paas woh ek cheez thi jisse sawaal ka jawaab diya ja sakta hai. Woh June ke ikatees failures ki list thi, unki ginti ke saath. Usne har ek ko chaar kismon mein se ek mein daala. Chaar isliye hain kyunki har kism alag ilaaj ki taraf ishaara karti hai. Shikayaton ko dher mein baantne jaisa sochiye.

Table 31.3: Failure ki chaar kismein aur unke ilaaj. Machine ko pata nahi. Matlab: Jawaab gaayab, purana ya banaya hua hai. Sahaj ki ginti aur ilaaj: Ikatees mein se koi nahi. Order numbers saboot ki problem thi, lookup se suljhi. Jaanti hai par galat behave karti hai. Matlab: Content sahi hai par format ya rule galat hai. Sahaj ki ginti aur ilaaj: Aath naam jinke baad "ji" hai: machine ko yeh convention dikhaya nahi gaya tha, aur ek worked example ne zyadatar ko ek dopahar mein theek kar diya. Aadhe chhupe addresses bhi format the. Woh hal nahi kar sakti. Matlab: Kai steps, ya asli ambiguity. Sahaj ki ginti aur ilaaj: Lines mein toote numbers, jo cutting rule ke the, machine ke nahi. Sahi hai par bahut mehngi. Matlab: Jawaab sahi hai aur keemat galat. Sahaj ki ginti aur ilaaj: Abhi problem nahi.

Friday ko Mr. Bhatia ko uska jawaab yeh tha. Fine-tuning behaviour sikhati hai, facts nahi. Agar shikayat yeh hoti ki model ko Sahaj ki policy nahi pata, toh fine-tuning galat auzaar hota. Lekin Sahaj ki shikayatein behaviour ki thi. Aur team ne abhi sasti cheezein aazmayi nahi thi. Pehli do ghanto mein palti ja sakti thi.

Usne woh kharche bhi likhe jo proposals chhod dete hain. Kisi ko examples banane padenge aur unhe taaza rakhna padega. Pehle ek test set chahiye, warna koi nahi bata sakta ki tuning ne madad ki ya nahi. Woh kabhi bhi un examples jaisa nahi hona chahiye jinse model ne seekha.
Har baar jab base model retire ho, tuning dobara karni padti hai. Aur faayda ek provider ke system ke andar rehta hai, instructions aur index mein nahi. Yeh bhi lock-in ka ek roop hai.

Mr. Bhatia ne poocha ki kya jawaab na hai. "Abhi nahi," usne kaha, aur order bataya. Pehle instructions, phir saboot, phir ek chhota model, phir fine-tuning. Agar "ji" wale naam pehle teen ke baad bhi fail hote rahe, toh team model ko sikhayegi. Aur use pata chal jaayega, kyunki uske paas key hai.

Chhota model woh option tha jis par usne bahut kam socha tha. Imran ko laga ki sabse zyada isi ka matlab hoga. Ek sasta, tez, chhote kaam wala model jo ghar mein chalta ho, aksar ek feature ke kharche ka hisaab tay kar deta hai. Yeh tab sach hai jab volume zyada ho aur kaam chhota aur tay ho. Chhote messages mein naam dhoondhna bilkul aisa hi kaam tha.
Saaraansh.

Ek kilo ke batkhare ko dobara yaad kijiye. Jab koi woh bechna chahe jo aapki team bana sakti hai, toh na price faisla karta hai na demo. Vendor ke product ko apni answer key par naapna karta hai. Chaar sawaal bhi karte hain. Kya yeh product ke kaam ka kendra hai? Ise kitni baar badalna padega? Toot jaaye toh kaun jaaga hai? Chhodne mein kya lagega?

Aksar achha jawaab hai plumbing khareedna aur woh hissa banana jo product ko alag banata hai. Date ke saath likhiye ki kaun si wajahein faisla ulat dengi. AI value chain ke upar model shayad hi edge hota hai. Unique data, workflow aur bharosa edge hain. Open-weight model company ki apni machines par chal sakta hai. Lock-in ek keemat hai jise naapna hai. Jab model kam pade, toh failure ki chaar kismein alag karni hain. Fine-tuning behaviour sikhati hai, facts nahi. Woh instructions, saboot aur chhote model ke baad aati hai, aur use alag test set chahiye.
Aage, Farah woh sawaal poochti hai jo tay karta hai ki tool use hoga ya nahi. Daswe jawaab ke baare mein woh apni team ko kya bataye?
